evidence.quote: What started as a beach resort grew into an iconic amusement park destination
Cedar Point accepts Visa, MasterCard, Discover & American Express for park admission
The Travel category includes purchases in a wide variety of merchant categories including: airlines, cruises, hotels and resorts, amusement parks
Includes ticket purchases for live entertainment, including concerts, live sporting events, live theatrical productions, amusement parks, and orchestras.
Entertainment purchases include ticket purchases at movie theaters, sports promoters (professional and semi-professional live events), theatrical promoters, concert promoters, amusement parks

draft.notes: The core business is an amusement-park destination, though the site also lists a CP Online Shop and gift shops. Bank of America groups amusement parks under Travel, while Citi and Discover include them in entertainment-related categories.
